name: 馬權威
objective:
課程內容涵蓋機械振動與噪音、聲學基礎、聲波傳播、聲音之反射與折射、聲學量測、振動抑制與隔離技術、噪音降低與吸音材料、消音器與噪音控制，以及相關法規與環境議題。
Topics include: Mechanical vibration and noise, Fundamentals of acoustics, Sound wave propagation, Reflection and refraction of sound, Acoustic measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Noise reduction and sound-absorbing materials, Silencers and noise control, Noise regulations, and Environmental considerations.
schedule:
Week Topic
1 Course introduction & vibration and noise control concepts
2 Vibration and noise fundamentals (I)
3 Vibration and noise fundamentals (II)
4 Vibration and noise transmission
5 Vibration and noise assessments
6 Noise and environmental sustainability
7 Mid-term exam
8 Noise prediction (I)
9 Noise prediction (II)
10 Mechanical vibration (I)
11 Mechanical vibration (II)
12 Instrumentation and standards
13 Signal processing & data science
14 Vibration and noise control methods
15-16 Final exam & Review
14-18 Flexible Learning
scorePolicy:
Subject Mark =
Attendance 20% +
Mid-term exam 30% +
Final exam 35% +
Student group practice and discussion 15%
